# Soul Ember

Soul Ember: The Last Light is a free-to-play dark-fantasy action roguelite by VALIXIS Games.

## Gameplay

- Eight playable heroes with distinct weapons, active skills, and signatures.
- Eighteen enemy archetypes and three multi-phase guardians.
- Keyboard-first combat: move with WASD or arrows, use Q and E skills, dodge with Space, and activate the signature with R.
- No account is required to play.

## Publisher

- VALIXIS Games
- Website: https://valixis.tech/
